basics.name: Abdulazeez Yisau Temitope
basics.label: Technical Product Builder
basics.summary: Technical product builder with 6+ years shipping payments, healthcare and operational platforms end to end. I work primarily in Node.js and NestJS with TypeScript and PostgreSQL, with production Go on a live payments exchange and a long background in PHP and Laravel, and I ship React, Next.js and React Native front ends. My work centres on systems where correctness matters: payout and settlement services, third-party API and webhook integrations, reconciliation, role-based access control and automated notification pipelines. I take products from business problem to production, often as the sole or lead engineer.

work.name: Atlax Exchange
work.summary: Digital asset and payments exchange (Atlax Finance Limited).
highlights: Build and maintain core backend services in Go and PostgreSQL, with an emphasis on transactional integrity and data consistency under load.
Payout and settlement services I work on processed 8,800+ transactions in a single week at a 98% success rate across two provider integrations.
Delivered a Nigerian partner-bank integration covering payouts, account name verification, bank listings and virtual-account deposit reconciliation against OAuth-secured APIs.
Built the bank provider abstraction: a canonical bank-code registry with internal routing, so provider-specific codes never reach users.
Built automated provider monitoring that tracks uptime and success rates and fails over after three consecutive failures, alerting the business team in real time.
Built the user tier system with daily and per-transaction limits and a compliance-controlled override, plus custom roles and team invites for business accounts.
Built a high-volume React transaction datatable with lazy loading, code splitting and Suspense.

work.name: DOKTA (Access Providence Healthcare Systems)
work.summary: Two-month contract building a telemedicine platform.
highlights: Took the platform from concept to launch readiness as the sole engineer: NestJS backend, React web app and React Native mobile client.
Completed a 42-item, ten-week delivery roadmap ahead of schedule, with weekly written and dashboard reporting to the chief executive.
Implemented a two-sided payment module: patient consultation billing and practitioner payouts, with reconciliation and transaction history.
Delivered real-time consultation over video, voice and text chat, plus the internal admin dashboard and call-centre tooling.

work.name: USAIY Limited
work.summary: Product studio that builds and runs its own platforms and client products.
highlights: Own architecture, delivery and infrastructure across the studio's platforms: Circlify and GiftPing (in maintenance mode while I rework them, reopening mid-2027), BureauOS (in development) and MÍRÀ Africa (currently offline).
Founded Circlify, a rotational savings (Ajo) and contributions platform rolled out under USAIY.
Design multi-tenant systems with role-based access control and granular permissions as standard on every build.
Build and operate transactional email and notification pipelines on self-hosted mail infrastructure.

work.name: Frootify
highlights: Owned the full Laravel backend for a production healthcare SaaS: stabilised delivery, authentication, multi-role access control and analytics.
Rewrote the web frontend in React with Vite, clearing accumulated technical debt and speeding up team delivery.
Built a React Native staff app with geo-fencing and device binding, shipped to production.
Launched Dispatch Hub, a public Laravel API for third-party delivery businesses; backend work on myBlongo contributed to a 5× increase in order throughput.

work.name: Virtuo
work.summary: Institutional operations platform: digital identity, cashless payments and administrative workflow.
highlights: Co-founded and built the platform; it reached 15,000+ active users across institutions, merchants and individuals before I exited in March 2026.
Led a 9-day sprint to a production payment collection and payout MVP on custom NFC hardware, writing the TCP communication layer from scratch.
Designed the NestJS backend, Next.js web dashboard and React Native mobile client, with distinct permission scopes per stakeholder type.

work.name: Vascon Solutions
work.summary: Joined as a junior engineer and grew into leading full-stack delivery on core modules.
highlights: Delivered four core modules of a government-facing Laravel application for the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board, becoming the sole engineer on it in later years.
Initiated and led the first phase of the migration from Laravel 4 to NestJS and Next.js, planning the target architecture, then kept contributing after the team lead took the migration forward.
Built a content management system that served as the backend foundation for a high-traffic e-commerce platform.
Handled VPS provisioning, deployment workflows and production reliability for the systems I owned.
